gulp is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1), [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [microcrawler-browser](@/work/microcrawler-browser.md): Proof-of-Concept: Microcrawler in your Browser!; [lethe.it](@/work/lethe-it.md): lethe.it - your personal smart links archive, organizer, classifier and much more; [microscratch](@/work/microscratch.md): Light Weight Web Framework using node.js, mongo, sockets, ember.js.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses gulp: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links gulp to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
